item.title: ARIA Hall of Fame Announces ‘Historic First’ Broadcast Deal
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we bring you the latest updates from the music world. Today, we're talking about a special event that's celebrating 40 years of Australian music. The Australian Recording Industry Association, or ARIA, is hosting a standalone Hall of Fame event, and it's going to be broadcast nationally on the Australian Broadcasting Corporation."
[Short music transition]
Host: "The event, presented on June 11th in Sydney, will feature six inductees: Gurrumul, Jenny Morris, Kate Ceberano, Spiderbait, The Living End, and Vika & Linda. These artists have shaped Australian culture and soundtracked generations. The show will also include performances by Kate Ceberano, Spiderbait, The Living End, Vika & Linda, Kate-Miller Heidke, Dan Sultan, and Mia Wray."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Myf Warhurst, a veteran broadcaster and music champion, will host the event. She says, 'These artists have shaped Australian culture, soundtracked generations, and influenced how we see ourselves through music.' The late Gurrumul will be remembered with a moving celebration, featuring his family members."
[Short music transition]
Host: "The event will air on June 11th at 9:15 pm AEST on the Australian Broadcasting Corporation, and then again on June 13th on ABC Entertains and the iView platform. You can also catch highlights and red carpet moments on ARIA and ABC social channels. The ARIA Hall of Fame Special Event is supported by the NSW Government and the Australian Government."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today. Tune in to the ARIA Hall of Fame event to celebrate 40 years of Australian music. Thanks for listening!"
